meta.title: Decision Engine
meta.description: A cheap judgement layer: before the main model acts, a small decision model answers structured questions (risk, reversibility, task relevance, injection suspicion) and the plugin allows, asks or blocks — or switches model, or skips an expensive call entirely. Works against any service exposing a decision endpoint (built-in system one / bamboonode / SiliconFlow presets, or a custom base URL). Shadow-first by default, fail-open on any error.
